Product Details: The MuscleGrid 3KW Hybrid Solar Inverter is a high-performance power solution designed for homes, offices, shops, farmhouses, and small commercial setups that require strong backup, high solar utilization, and smart energy management. Built on a 48V/51.2V battery platform, this inverter supports high-capacity battery banks of up to 800Ah, making it suitable for longer backup applications and demanding load requirements. With a rated capacity of 3KW, the inverter is engineered to handle up to 6.5KW continuous load and a powerful 13KVA surge load, allowing it to support heavy appliances and sudden startup loads more confidently than many standard market inverters. It also supports up to 9KW solar PV input, helping users maximize solar generation and reduce electricity bills. As a hybrid solar inverter, MuscleGrid works with solar panels, battery, grid power, and generator input, giving customers greater flexibility in energy usage. It is also designed to support grid export / net metering, allowing eligible customers to sell excess solar electricity back to the grid where permitted by local regulations and DISCOM policies. The inverter is BIS certified, offering customers additional confidence in quality and compliance. It features a smart LCD display for real-time monitoring and easy configuration, along with multiple protection features such as overload protection, overheat protection, battery low protection, short-circuit protection, and over/under-voltage protection. Every purchase also includes access to MuscleGrid Premium CRM, where customers can register their warranty, book video consultations, log support tickets, track service requests, extend warranty, and access after-sales support easily from one place. Designed for reliability, performance, and customer convenience, the MuscleGrid 3KW Hybrid Solar Inverter is a complete solar power management solution for users who want more than just backup power.
